blurb: The museum at Kolomoki Mounds is undergoing operational changes to abide by the updated regulations of the Native American Graves Protection and Repatriation Act (NAGPRA). There is currently not a museum experience offered at this time. However, ranger-led programs and guided tours of the site are offered frequently.
